Privacy and cookies

This page covers the public alternpress.com presentation, not every installation of the AlternPress software.

Controller and contact

SERVER TAMER DI DANIELE VANTAGGIATO. For requests about personal data: info@vantax.eu.

Cookies and resources

This static presentation sets no application cookies and uses no browser storage, analytics, personalised advertising, pixels or remote fonts. IT/EN links include the language directly in the URL. This does not mean the server receives no technical data.

The administrative area of the separate vantax.eu site uses a protected technical session for access and security; this presentation does not set it.

Request information and security

To deliver pages the server receives the IP address and information sent with the request. Apache logs include time, IP, requested URL, status, data volume, Referer and User-Agent; they are used for service delivery and security, not behavioural analytics or advertising.

The Apache log rotation configuration specifies 14 archives, rotating daily when data is present. A rotation count alone is not a maximum retention period for inactive archives or backups, which require separate management.

External links and rights

GitHub and other website links are not embeds: following them opens services operated by other providers with separate processing.

To exercise access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection rights where applicable, contact the controller. A complaint may be submitted to the Italian data protection authority.
